description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ChannelListing/MonitorExistingListing. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Imports or monitors existing channel listings in HGR. Imported listings are always activated. ownerAgent: publication. Use when: Use when concrete existing store listing/product ids and source URLs are already selected and the user wants HGR to monitor/import those existing listings. Input: [FromBody] model: AddListingModel. Main fields: OAuthId: int, Listings: ListingToMonitor[]. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. ToRelist is currently ignored. UserDevice is optional HGRWeb client telemetry; AI chat and MCP must omit it and must not invent a device value. Output: Returns import/monitoring results with inserted, invalid, repeated and quota-related entries. Imported eBay API variations preserve VAT when the store supplies it; unknown VAT is not inferred from the publication default. Search terms: channellisting monitorexistinglisting. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally. Internal-only request fields are removed automatically before the HGRApi request is sent.

body.description: HGRApi POST /api/ChannelListing/MonitorExistingListing request body. Internal-only request fields are removed automatically.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
